authentication.description: No authentication. Reads are free and need no key or token.

description: LocalePak is Pakistan's business directory (183 cities, 24 categories). This MCP server exposes the public directory as read-only tools: search businesses by keyword, city, or category; get one business by slug; list categories; list cities. Public fields only — no owner emails, owner IDs, or payment data. Reads are free with no key; at most 20 results per call.
name: LocalePak MCP Server

tools.description: Search public LocalePak business listings by keyword, city, and/or category. At most 20 listings per call.
tools.name: search_businesses

tools.description: Get a single public LocalePak business listing by its slug.
tools.name: get_business

tools.description: List the 183 Pakistani cities LocalePak covers. At most 20 per call.
tools.name: list_cities
